name: Fired ability with a target per clause: each target is judged by its own words
notes: Gurmag Rakshasa's "target creature an opponent controls gets -2/-2 … and target creature you control gets +2/+2" listed your creatures for the second picker, but picking one changed nothing: _addAbilityPseudo stamped the earliest target restriction of the ability ("an opponent controls") on every effect as _abilityTargetRestriction, and effectAppliesToPerm's fire-time check refused your creature for the +2/+2. Monoist Circuit-Feeder was the mirror case ("you control" stamped on the -0/-X). A slotted effect now takes the earliest restriction of its own slot, in _addAbilityPseudo and the command-zone path alike. Found by the audit's check of texts with several targets (tests/audit.js classifyTargets).

scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.
